description: O50: dependency updates arrive as PRs by themselves. Bot PRs merge by the same rule as any PR: CI green and a non-author verdict that read the changelog.

One rule for every package: a version under 3 days old is held back. No branch and no PR is made for it; it is listed by name under 'Pending Status Checks' on the Dependency Dashboard issue until it is old enough.
Security fixes are not held (Renovate's vulnerability alerts skip the wait; they need Dependabot alerts turned on in the repository settings).
Not covered: the age of packages pulled in underneath (the lockfile's transitive entries); Renovate does not pass the wait to pnpm.

packageRules.description: The agent engines (Claude and Codex adapters, the ACP SDK) come as one PR, checked at any time.
Every other npm package, the packageManager pnpm pin included, comes as a second PR.
GitHub Actions come as one PR, weekly (Monday before 04:00).
